tools.name: search_bonuses
tools.description: Use when a user wants to find a US bank account, savings, credit card or brokerage signup bonus, or asks which offers are worth opening. Returns matching offers sorted by bonus value, highest first — except when balance_transfer is true, which sorts by intro window instead.

tools.name: get_bonus
tools.description: Use before recommending an offer, to read its exact requirements, minimum deposit, direct-deposit rules, expiry date, state availability and the date its terms were last verified. Quote the requirements rather than paraphrasing money amounts.

tools.name: expiring_soon
tools.description: Use when timing matters — a user asking what is about to end, or whether to act now. Offers with no stated end date are never included here.

tools.name: compare_bonuses
tools.description: Use when a user is choosing between specific offers. Returns each offer's key fields plus a summary naming the highest bonus and the earliest expiry.

tools.name: benefits_api_docs
tools.description: Use when you need field definitions, ordering guarantees or the error format before calling another tool.

tools.name: benefits_examples
tools.description: Use to copy a working example call instead of guessing tool arguments.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "benefits_api_docs" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use when you need field definitions, ordering guarantees or the error format before calling another tool.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_bonuses" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use when a user wants to find a US bank account, savings, or credit card signup bonus, or asks which offers are worth opening. Returns matching offers sorted by bonus value, highest first." → after: "Use when a user wants to find a US bank account, savings, credit card or brokerage signup bonus, or asks which offers are worth opening. Returns matching offers sorted by bonus value, highest first — except when balance_transfer is true, which sorts by intro window instead."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
